title: Google Maps Scraper

searches.title: Search terms
searches.description: Business type or keyword, one per entry, exactly as typed into Google Maps: ["dentist"] or ["coffee shop", "bakery"]. Every term is searched in every entry of `locations`, so do not repeat the city here. A full phrase that already says where ("pubs near Prague 2") also works with `locations` left empty.
searches.sectionDescription: Search terms × locations. Filters, contacts and monitoring below are optional.

locations.title: Locations
locations.description: Where to search, as free text, one per entry: ["Austin, TX"], ["Lyon, France"], ["Shibuya, Tokyo"], a ZIP code or a neighbourhood. Add the state or country when a name is ambiguous. Each location is verified on Google Maps first: an unknown location ends that search with an explanation and $0 charged, never with places from somewhere else.

maxPlacesPerSearch.title: Max places per search
maxPlacesPerSearch.description: Maximum delivered places per search term per location, counted after filters. Base price: N × $0.004. With enrichContacts, add $0.003 per place where an email or social/WhatsApp link is found (maximum N × $0.007 total). onlyWithEmail costs $0.007 per delivered place. A cap is not a guarantee enough matches exist. One Google Maps query lists about 120–220 places; fullCoverage searches a grid.

enrichContacts.title: Find emails & social links
enrichContacts.description: true = read each place's website for emails, phone numbers and social/WhatsApp links (up to maxPagesPerSite pages). Adds $0.003 only when an email or social/WhatsApp link is found; phone-only findings do not trigger this fee. The $0.004 base place fee still applies. No website, blocked site or no contact found = no contact fee. For email-bearing places only, use onlyWithEmail. Default false.
enrichContacts.sectionDescription: $0.003 per place with an email or social/WhatsApp link found on its website, in addition to the $0.004 base place fee. No contact found = no contact fee.

onlyWithEmail.title: Only places with an email
onlyWithEmail.description: true = deliver and bill only places with an email found on their website. Automatically enables enrichContacts and reads further down the results toward maxPlacesPerSearch after filters. $0.007 per delivered place including base and contact fees: up to 50 costs $0.35. Places without found email are omitted and free. Enough matches are not guaranteed; addresses are extracted, not deliverability-verified.

hasWebsite.title: Website
hasWebsite.description: "any" (default), "yes" = only places that list a website, "no" = only places WITHOUT a website (prospects for web design and marketing agencies). Free; filtered places are not charged.
hasWebsite.sectionDescription: A place a filter rejects costs nothing; the status row reports how many each filter removed.

hasPhone.title: Phone
hasPhone.description: "any" (default), "yes" = only places with a phone number, "no" = only places without one. Free; filtered places are not charged.

isClaimed.title: Claimed listing
isClaimed.description: "any" (default), "no" = only UNCLAIMED listings (Google still shows "Claim this business": owners who have not set up their profile — prospects for local SEO and profile management), "yes" = only claimed listings. Free; filtered places are not charged.

minRating.title: Min rating
minRating.description: Keep places rated at least this many stars (1–5). 0 = no limit. Places with no rating do not pass. Free filter.

maxRating.title: Max rating
maxRating.description: Keep places rated at most this many stars, e.g. 3.9 to find low rated businesses for reputation services. 0 = no limit. Places with no rating do not pass. Free filter.

minReviews.title: Min reviews
minReviews.description: Keep places with at least this many Google reviews (established businesses). 0 = no limit. Free filter.

maxReviews.title: Max reviews
maxReviews.description: Keep places with at most this many Google reviews (new or under-marketed businesses). 0 = no limit. Free filter.

categoriesInclude.title: Categories to include
categoriesInclude.description: Keep a place only if one of its Google Maps categories contains one of these words, case-insensitive: ["dentist", "dental"]. Removes off-topic results before they are charged.

skipClosed.title: Skip closed places
skipClosed.description: Set true to drop permanently and temporarily closed places before billing.

onlyNew.title: Only new places
onlyNew.description: Leave false for a one-time list. Set true only for repeated monitoring: deliver and bill place IDs not delivered by earlier runs with the same monitorKey. The first run returns the current matching places; later runs return newly seen places, not confirmed business openings. Use a separate monitorKey for each list. Default false.

monitorKey.title: Monitor key
monitorKey.description: Name of the memory `onlyNew` compares against. Use one key per list you maintain, e.g. "austin-dentists". Letters, digits, dash, underscore.

startUrls.title: Google Maps URLs, place ids or CIDs
startUrls.description: Known places or saved searches instead of (or besides) `searches`, e.g. ["ChIJb5gBC-u0RIYRHkntaUcdJGs", "https://maps.google.com/?cid=7720327853776914718"]. Accepts Google Maps place URLs, search URLs (google.com/maps/search/…), short links (maps.app.goo.gl/…), place IDs (ChIJ…) and CIDs. A place returns one full row: use it to look up the phone, website or emails of specific businesses.
startUrls.sectionCaption: Known places: URLs, place IDs, CIDs

language.title: Language
language.description: Language for source category names, opening hours and descriptions. Default en; examples: de, fr, es, pt-BR, ja, ar. Use zh-CN for Simplified Chinese (verified category labels); it does not change the search location or guarantee every name is translated. locations chooses the target place; country disambiguates location and formats phone numbers.

country.title: Country
country.description: Two-letter country code Google should assume for ambiguous names and phone formats: us, gb, de, fr, br, in, jp, ae … Default us.

fullCoverage.title: Full coverage (grid)
fullCoverage.description: Set true to collect MORE than the ~120–220 places one Google Maps query lists: the area is split into a grid and every cell is searched. Works with `locations` or with latitude/longitude/radiusKm, `boundingBox` or `polygon`. Each place is still delivered and charged once.
fullCoverage.sectionDescription: Go past Google's per-query limit with a grid, or search a circle, bounding box or polygon instead of named locations.

maxPlacesTotal.title: Max places in the whole run
maxPlacesTotal.description: Hard cap across every search in the run. 0 = no cap beyond the per-search limit and your spending limit.

latitude.title: Latitude
latitude.description: Centre of a circular search area, for example 30.2672. Use with Longitude and Radius instead of Locations.

longitude.title: Longitude
longitude.description: Centre of a circular search area, for example -97.7431.

radiusKm.title: Radius (km)
radiusKm.description: Radius around the centre, 0.2–200 km. Google ranks by prominence as well as distance, so turn on "Only inside my area" to drop anything beyond this radius before billing.

withinRadiusOnly.title: Only inside my area
withinRadiusOnly.description: Drop places outside the circle, box or polygon before billing. Without it Google may include prominent places a little beyond the area.

polygon.title: Polygon
polygon.description: A custom shape as a list of [latitude, longitude] points, for example [[30.20,-97.80],[30.30,-97.80],[30.25,-97.70]]. (A GeoJSON Polygon object is accepted through the API.)

gridCellKm.title: Grid cell size (km)
gridCellKm.description: Side of one grid cell in km (0.5–50). 0 = size cells automatically so the area fits in Max grid cells. Smaller cells find more places in dense cities and take longer.

maxGridCells.title: Max grid cells
maxGridCells.description: Upper bound on cells per search; cells are searched from the centre outwards.

categoriesExclude.title: Categories to exclude
categoriesExclude.description: Drop a place if any of its Google Maps categories contains one of these words: ["supplier", "school"].

nameContains.title: Name contains
nameContains.description: Keep a place only if its name contains one of these words.

nameExcludes.title: Name excludes
nameExcludes.description: Drop a place if its name contains any of these words — for example chain names.

excludePlaceIds.title: Skip these place ids
excludePlaceIds.description: Place ids (ChIJ…), CIDs or feature ids you already have. They are skipped before billing.

excludeDatasetId.title: Skip places from a dataset
excludeDatasetId.description: Id of an earlier dataset of this actor: every place_id in it is skipped before billing.

maxPagesPerSite.title: Pages to read per website
maxPagesPerSite.description: Home page plus the most promising contact, about, team and imprint pages, up to this many.

proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy
proxyConfiguration.description: Apify datacenter proxies work for Google Maps and are the default; residential is not needed.

searchStringsArray.title: Search terms (compatibility alias)
searchStringsArray.description: Same as Search terms. Accepted so an input saved for another Google Maps actor can be pasted unchanged.

locationQuery.title: Location (compatibility alias)
locationQuery.description: Same as one entry in Locations.

maxCrawledPlacesPerSearch.title: Max places per search (compatibility alias)
maxCrawledPlacesPerSearch.description: Same as Max places per search.

description: Find local businesses on Google Maps and return them as lead rows with phone, website, rating and hours; optionally add emails and social links from each website. Minimal input: {"searches": ["dentist"], "locations": ["Austin, TX"], "maxPlacesPerSearch": 50}.
